cohort: 164 healthy women in their third trimester of pregnancy in Kerman, Iran.
finding: The incidence of postpartum depression within two months after delivery was 9.8% and was associated with lower education level, unplanned pregnancy, cesarean section, and lower social support.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was associated with an increased incidence of postpartum depression (adjusted hazard ratio = 0.57, 95% CI = 0.36; 0.97).
